201.description: Reverse label issued (or replayed for a known Idempotency-Key).

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the response is a replay of the answer stored for the Idempotency-Key.

schema.description: Metadata of a reverse label, the label of one package of a customer return (ADR 0017). Never contains the ship-to address. A reverse label has no purchase order and no fulfillment assignment, so it carries neither poNumber nor assignmentId; it always carries purpose RETURN and the returnAuthorizationId it belongs to. orderId is the outbound order whose ship-to is the return's pickup address.

purpose.description: Always RETURN. An outbound label (the Label schema) has no purpose property.

returnAuthorizationId.description: The return authorization the reverse label belongs to.

schema.title: ReturnLabel

400.description: idempotency-key-required (the Idempotency-Key header is missing) or idempotency-key-invalid (not 1-128 printable ASCII characters).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

409.description: label-already-issued (a label already covers this (returnAuthorizationId, packageNo)), destination-prefix-unavailable (this context holds no usable destination prefix for destinationNodeId; it may hold one later, once the node's registration has been consumed. Like concurrent-update, this refusal is NOT stored under the Idempotency-Key, so a retry of the same request with the same key is executed again and is served once the node is known; ADR 0018), tracking-number-taken (ErrTrackingNumberTaken), concurrent-update (ErrConcurrentUpdate) or idempotency-key-reused (the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

422.description: validation-failed (a malformed request, or the order is unknown to customer-ordering).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

500.description: internal-error. An unmapped failure; the detail never carries the cause. Never cached by the idempotency middleware, so the same key retries the work.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

503.description: ship-to-unavailable. customer-ordering did not return the ship-to in time. No label is stored.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.
